title: Legal Consultation
description: A structured first opinion on where you stand. You leave the session knowing the legal position, the realistic outcomes, the likely timeline and what it will cost — in writing, whether or not you engage us further.
imageAlt: Advocate reviewing case documents with a client across a consultation table
benefits: Written summary of position and options after the session
Candid view on merits, including when not to litigate
Fee estimate before any engagement begins
Available in person, by video call or by telephone

title: Litigation & Court Representation
description: End-to-end conduct of your matter before trial courts, tribunals, District Courts and the High Court — pleadings, evidence, arguments and execution, handled by the advocate who briefed you.
imageAlt: Interior of a courtroom with the bench and advocates' podium
benefits: Written update after every listed hearing
Continuity of counsel — no unexplained substitutions
Interim relief pursued early where assets are at risk
Execution and enforcement included in the mandate

title: Drafting & Documentation
description: Agreements, deeds, petitions, replies and settlements drafted from scratch for your facts. We do not adapt templates and hope for the best — clauses are written to hold when they are tested.
imageAlt: Legal agreement being drafted with a fountain pen and seal
benefits: Bespoke drafting, never recycled boilerplate
Plain-language explanation of every operative clause
Two rounds of revision included as standard
Registration and stamping handled where applicable

title: Legal Notices & Replies
description: A properly drafted notice resolves a surprising share of disputes without litigation, and strengthens your record if it does not. We also draft measured replies to notices you have received.
imageAlt: Sealed legal notice envelope on a desk beside a law book
benefits: Drafted and dispatched typically within 48 hours
Sent by registered post and email with proof of service
Framed to support the suit that may follow
Fixed fee, quoted before we begin

title: Due Diligence & Legal Opinion
description: Title searches, corporate diligence and transaction opinions that tell you what you are actually buying — including the defects that cannot be cured and the risks worth walking away from.
imageAlt: Magnifying glass over property title documents and revenue records
benefits: Written opinion stating risk plainly, not hedged into uselessness
Defects separated into curable and non-curable
Direct advice on whether to proceed or renegotiate
Turnaround agreed in advance to suit your deal timeline

title: Corporate Compliance Advisory
description: Retainer advisory that keeps a business on the right side of company, tax and data protection obligations, with a calendar so filings and renewals never lapse unnoticed.
imageAlt: Compliance checklist and corporate statutory registers
benefits: Annual compliance calendar with owner and due date per item
Monthly retainer covering routine queries without per-hour billing
Policy and contract templates maintained as the law changes
Escalation path to litigation counsel within the same firm

title: Registrations & Filings
description: Company and LLP incorporation, property registration, GST registration and society formation — handled as a managed process with status visibility, not a black box.
imageAlt: Registration certificate with an official seal and ribbon
benefits: Document checklist provided upfront so nothing stalls midway
Government fees stated separately from professional fees
Status updates at each stage of the filing
Objections and examination reports handled without extra charge

title: Online & NRI Consultation
description: Video and telephone consultation for clients outside the city or abroad, with documents exchanged securely and powers of attorney arranged so you need not travel for routine appearances.
imageAlt: Video consultation between an advocate and a remote client
benefits: Appointments scheduled across time zones
Secure document exchange and e-signature where permitted
Power of attorney and vakalatnama arranged remotely
Experience with NRI property, divorce and succession matters
